ETag.description: The weak entity tag of the appointment or carrier, `W/"<version>"`.

state.description: `BOOKED -> CHECKED_IN -> COMPLETED`, `BOOKED/CHECKED_IN -> CANCELLED`, `BOOKED -> NO_SHOW`; the last three are terminal.
state.title: AppointmentState

implicit.description: True when the arrival is implied by a door release that came before any gate fact.

atRisk.description: True after a late ETA or a door reassignment that overlaps this window; cleared by an on-time ETA or a reschedule.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, an invalid path, query or header parameter, or a NUL byte in a body.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or NUL byte

value.title: Malformed request body
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

idempotencyKeyInvalid.summary: Idempotency-Key longer than 128 characters or not printable ASCII

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is invalid
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key header must be 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters

value.title: Limit is invalid
value.detail: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500

invalidCursor.summary: cursor is not a page token

value.title: Cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a valid page token

unknownQueryParameter.summary: A query parameter the collection does not declare

value.title: Query parameter is not supported
value.detail: query parameter is not supported: after

invalidQueryParameter.summary: A query parameter with a value that does not parse

value.title: Query parameter is invalid
value.detail: query parameter is invalid: state must be BOOKED, CHECKED_IN, COMPLETED, CANCELLED or NO_SHOW

invalidPathParameter.summary: A path parameter that is not an id of its kind

value.title: Path parameter is invalid
value.detail: path parameter is invalid: appointmentId: appointment id must be appt-<uuid>

invalidIfMatch.summary: An If-Match that is not an ETag of this service

value.title: If-Match header is invalid
value.detail: If-Match must be the ETag of the resource

invalidAvailabilityQuery.summary: from and to are required, from < to, at most 14 days

value.title: Availability query is invalid
value.detail: availability range must be from < to, at most 14 days, minutes 1..240

404.description: No appointment, door, closure or carrier has this id, or the path holds a NUL byte.
